prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web dashboard hero redesign decision comp for eBuhay
Primary request: Create Option A, "Civic Status Docket", for an established Philippine donation and transplant demo. Show one 1536x1024 design board containing three realistic full-width dashboard opening sections stacked vertically: Recipient, Donor, and Hospital Administrator. Each strip must read as an actual responsive web application viewport crop, not a poster.
Structure: Every strip has a quiet white or cloud canvas and a 1200px content container. Use an asymmetric two-column hero. Left column contains a small plain-text role label, a strong Figtree headline, and one concise support sentence. Right column contains one integrated tactile status docket with a dominant status line and compact structured facts. No calls to action. Immediately below each hero, hint at the unchanged thin network band and pill tab navigation so the page mode is unmistakable.
Recipient content: label "RECIPIENT DASHBOARD"; headline "Your care journey, clearly in view."; supporting copy "Track your match status and the details guiding your next step."; status "Clinical review in progress"; facts "Blood O+", "Kidney", "High urgency".
Donor content: label "DONOR DASHBOARD"; headline "Your pledge is ready when it matters."; supporting copy "Keep your donation details current while eBuhay looks for a compatible recipient."; status "Registry active"; facts "Blood O-", "2 organs pledged", "Available".
Hospital content: label "HOSPITAL ADMINISTRATION"; headline "Philippine General Hospital"; supporting line "Match triage and institutional review"; identifier "PGH-MNL-1000"; location "Taft Avenue, Manila"; dominant metric "8 Pending review"; secondary metrics "3 Approved matches", "1 Active procedure", "2 Consultations today".
Style/medium: polished high-fidelity web UI mockup, semantic HTML/CSS appearance, crisp text, no photography.
Color palette: eBuhay Blue #0038A8, navy #06145B, Lifeline Red #CE1126, Hope Gold #F59E0B, Recovery Green #059669, white #FFFFFF, cloud #F8FAFC, ink #0F172A, slate #64748B.
Typography: Figtree-like bold friendly civic headings; Noto Sans-like body; disciplined tight hierarchy.
Materials: white working surfaces, 1px pale slate borders, 12-16px corners, restrained ambient shadows, tactile status treatments.
Focal moment: the right-side status docket, with a navy field and one semantic color signal per role; the rest remains quiet.
Constraints: This is visibly an eBuhay demo/prototype dashboard, not an official government portal. Preserve role distinction. No behavior changes, no buttons, no illustrations, no gradients, no dotted grids, no blur blobs, no glassmorphism, no huge title filling the screen, no bento grid, no emoji, no fake official seals, no DICT endorsement, no medical claims, no real patient data, no watermark.
